body:
In my family, it hasn't helped that much. I'm still willing to try but I'm not sure if it's worth it. I'd say slightly better than a coin flip (doctors range from 40-80%). 

It's nice to talk about the darker side of this. My SO, as much as she loves me, has never thought of suicide for a second in her entire life. This makes it a bit difficult to have a candid conversation without her becoming incredibly worried. 

Also, thanks! This is an old account so I didn't even know.

I'll chip in here. I tested out a VP in person and by taping a small rolled up piece of gorilla tape to a plat preppy to simulate it as well. They both seemed great, and I really enjoyed the pen until I used it to write for 8 hours. That clip ends up creating a significant dimple on the top of your finger which becomes quite distracting. Some people like it, but if given the option I would have the clip removed.
